data.name: Erisha
data.gender_notes: Erisha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Erisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Eesha’, which means 'Goddess of Love and Fertility'. In Hindu mythology, the Goddess Eesha, also known as Parvati, is the consort of Lord Shiva. She is often depicted as the embodiment of love, fertility, and motherhood. The name Erisha carries the meaning “Goddess of Love and Fertility” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Erisha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and fertility and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodiment of Love, Fertility, and Motherhood
data.etymology: Erisha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Love and Fertility.”
